description: This file defines symbolic functions for ONNX export of PyTorch operators corresponding to ONNX opset 16, specifically focusing on operator export logic such as grid sampling and scatter operations.

methods.name: grid_sampler( g: jit_utils.GraphContext, input, grid, mode_enum, padding_mode_enum, align_corners, )

methods.name: scatter_add(g: jit_utils.GraphContext, self, dim, index, src)
methods.description: Implements the symbolic ONNX export for the scatter_add operation, supporting shape adjustments and type casting.

methods.description: Implements the symbolic ONNX export for scatter_reduce with support for reduction modes and dynamic shape handling.
